claims.claim: Ps5 console fat uk used with 1 pad
claims.evidence: Witness photos show a white PlayStation console with a controller, but do not show the exact model/version (PS5 vs other) or confirm 'fat' or 'UK' region.

claims.claim: Neatly used, never opened or repaired
claims.evidence: No photo evidence of seals/opening, internal condition, or repair history.
Photos do not show temperature/thermal behavior or port testing.

claims.claim: Comes with the original pads and the UK receipt
claims.evidence: Photos show a controller, but do not show receipt/UK paperwork or confirm accessories count/contents.

risks.risk: Model/version uncertainty (PS5 vs another PlayStation; 'fat' not confirmed). Wrong model pricing risk.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the console label/serial sticker showing the exact model (e.g., CFI-xxxx) and region, plus the back/side model markings.
risks.if_unproven: Price as the worst-case for the shown item category: an unverified PlayStation console with unknown exact model and unknown storage.

risks.risk: Power-on/boot status unknown (could fail to boot, crash, or show errors).
risks.proof: Short video clip of powering on and reaching the home screen (with system menu visible).
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully proven working (worst-case: may be faulty/untested).

risks.risk: Controller condition unknown (stick drift, button issues, charging/port health).
risks.proof: Video showing controller connected and working: analog stick movement test in-game/menu, button presses, and charging/USB port check.
risks.if_unproven: Price as controller condition unknown (worst-case: may need repair/replacement).

risks.risk: Disc drive status unknown (if it’s a disc model, it may not read discs).
risks.proof: Clip inserting a disc and showing it being read (disc icon appears / plays).
risks.if_unproven: Price as disc drive unverified (worst-case: disc drive may be unreliable).

risks.risk: Port functionality unknown (HDMI/USB/charging ports may be damaged).
risks.proof: Photo/video of each port being used: HDMI connected to TV and video output confirmed; USB ports used for controller charging/connection.
risks.if_unproven: Price as ports unverified (worst-case: some ports may not work).

risks.risk: Overheating/thermal issues not verifiable from photos (fan noise, dust buildup, thermal throttling).
risks.proof: Video of a short stress/usage session (e.g., loading a game) with the console running, plus a quick sound check of fan behavior.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potential thermal issue risk (worst-case: may overheat under load).

risks.risk: Accessories and receipt not shown (could be missing cables/stand/box; receipt may not exist).
risks.proof: Photo of everything laid out: power cable, HDMI cable, controller(s), any stand/box, and the UK receipt clearly visible.
risks.if_unproven: Price as incomplete bundle (worst-case: only console + 1 controller, no receipt/box).

proof_requests: Clear photo of the console serial/model label (CFI-xxxx) and region/variant to confirm exact PS5 model and whether it is disc or digital.
Short video: power on and boot to the home screen (system menu visible).
Video test of the controller: analog stick drift check in a menu/game, all buttons responsive, and charging/USB port working.
If disc version: video inserting a disc and showing it reads/plays.
Photos/videos showing each port in use (HDMI output to TV, USB/controller charging).
Photo/video of the full accessory list laid out, including the UK receipt clearly shown.
response.reason: The witness confirms it’s a white PlayStation console with a controller, but the key details needed to price a PS5 'fat' UK unit (exact model/variant, storage, working/boot status, disc drive, controller health, and accessories/receipt) are not verifiable from the provided shots.
